name: s07-version-resolver
command:
import pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,shutil
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
work=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="sub2api-release-119-resolver-"))
script=work/"backend/scripts/resolve-version.sh"
script.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy2(root/"backend/scripts/resolve-version.sh",script)
version=work/"backend/cmd/server/VERSION"
version.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
version.write_text("1.1.19\n")
def run(*args):
 return subprocess.check_output(["rtk","proxy",*args],cwd=work,text=True).strip()
def check(label,expected):
 actual=run("sh",str(script)); print(label+": "+actual,flush=True); assert actual==expected
check("no git repository uses VERSION","1.1.19")
for args in [("init","-q"),("config","user.name","Release Version Fixture"),("config","user.email","release-fixture@example.com"),("commit","--allow-empty","-q","-m","fixture")]:
 run("git",*args)
check("untagged HEAD uses VERSION","1.1.19")
run("git","tag","-a","v9.9.8","-m","fixture tag precedence")
check("exact annotated v-tag takes precedence","9.9.8")
run("git","commit","--allow-empty","-q","-m","next fixture")
check("after tagged commit uses VERSION","1.1.19")
run("git","tag","-a","v1.1.19","-m","release fixture")
check("target annotated tag resolves 1.1.19","1.1.19")
print("workspace tags and HEAD untouched",flush=True)
shutil.rmtree(work)
